name: Replicating Nanobot
description: (Tag:resource)(Tag:tech)A palm-sized swarm of self-copying nanobots. Once a day you give each bot one of two orders: split in two, or mint a single gold coin. Splitting doubles the swarm, so a batch told to replicate gives up today's income for a much larger one later, and the same swarm told to mint produces coins in proportion to its size. They never wear out and never stop following orders.
